title: Grammar: ask and answer basic questions (review g10)
subtitle: Unit 12: Work and studies

steps.title: Simple questions about work or school
ask and answer basic questions (review g10)
steps.body:
• Use a question word to ask for the missing detail: où for place, quand for a day or date, and à quelle heure for a time.
• For an easy spoken question, use a rising voice: Tu travailles aujourd'hui ? You can also begin with est-ce que.
• Answer with one complete sentence. Reuse the same verb and add the detail: À quelle heure ? Je commence à huit heures.

steps.prompt: You want to know the place of the class.
You want to know the day of the interview.
You want to know the exact start time.
options: À quelle heure commence le quart ?
steps.explain: À quelle heure asks for a clock time.

steps.prompt: Which question asks what a person does for work?
options: À quelle heure est le cours ?
steps.explain: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ? asks what you do.
